frame.name: Wave Frame
frame.description: One-shot handheld Grenade Launcher. Projectiles release a wave of energy when they contact the ground.

origins.name: Dawning Surprise
origins.description: Defeating targets awards a Dawning gift. Defeated powerful targets count as more than one.

origins.name: Field-Tested
origins.description:
Defeating targets or dealing damage with this weapon gradually increases range, stability, handling, and reload speed.

Swords gain increased charge rate and guard resistance.

enhanced.name: Rimestealer

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Impromptu Ammunition
perks.description: Final blows increase ammo meter progress from all sources for a short time.

enhanced.name: Crystalline Corpsebloom
